notes.title: Killer Gin Optimized for Low and High End GPUs 2.0!!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays!

I wish you and yours, Joy and Happiness!
And as a holiday present:

Killer Gin Optimized 2.0!!

- KG is now fully optimized for low end GPUs
- NW.js version 49.2
- STEAM version 1.5
- Game Guide Updated (and searchable)
- Make sure your Good GPU, not integrated is running KG (Guide has a walk through for you, best performance)

Regardless if you are accidentally using your Integrated GPU by accident, Killer Gin is FULLY optimized now.

Please Note: 

GPU update!

This information can help with ALL games in general.

If you have a good computer and KG is running slow.

Make sure that your best GPU is running Killer Gin.

Many computers have an integrated (CRAP) GPU and a Good GPU

So check your GPU settings and make sure that your good GPU is set to run Killer Gin (Game.exe)

Make sure your Good GPU is set to run Killer Gin on Optimal settings and hit apply (easier to find with game running, it should be “Game.exe” on the list)

Now shut down KG and restart, it should run MUCH better now.

Example: So if you have an NVIDIA Card, open up "NVIDIA Control Panel" and update the Global and Program Settings in 3D Settings.(There should be tabs in 3D settings).

Make sure KG (Game.exe or nw for Linux) is using the best GPU, apply settings, and restart Killer Gin. 

Enjoy.

This is the very last update, Killer Gin is as optimized as possible.
If you have 2 GPUs, make sure the good one is running Killer Gin, many use the bad GPU by default.

This could happen to any game, so keep this in mind.

Now that KG is as optimized as possible
I can finally concentrate on:
The KG Drake DLC, there will be Dragons, coming soon!

Have a wonderful Holiday Break!

(So go ahead, download the newest/last version today!)
